mapper.select: SELECT notice.id , notice.deleted , notice.created_at as createdAt , notice.modified_at as modifiedAt , notice.admin_id as adminId , notice.title , notice.content , notice.pinned FROM notice WHERE notice.id = #{id}

SELECT notice.id FROM notice
ORDER BY notice.pinned DESC, notice.id DESC
SELECT count(notice.id) as listsize FROM notice

SELECT notice.id FROM notice
ORDER BY notice.id DESC ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perpage}

SELECT notice.id FROM notice
ORDER BY notice.pinned DESC, notice.id DESC LIMIT 0, #{perpage}
